optical_segment_unit_check.scope:
Execute the current renderer's integration segment against a homogeneous slab.

This isolates the optical segment arithmetic copied verbatim from the shipped
GLSL. It does not test scattering, reconstruction, jitter, empty-space traversal,
or calibrated flame appearance. Half-float readback tolerance is explicit.

chapters.title: REFINED WOOD FIRE
chapters.note: Five log-surface emitters. Temperature and species advect on the refined grid.

chapters.title: CANDLE / WICK + WAX
chapters.note: Wick source, wax geometry, low-flow combustion surrogate; no wax melting model.

chapters.title: THREE CANDLES
chapters.note: Three independent spatial source regions in one advected volume.

chapters.title: GAS STOVE / SINGLE RING
chapters.note: Twenty modeled ports; reaction-linked blue emission, not a recolored wood flame.

chapters.title: GAS STOVE / FOUR BURNERS
chapters.note: Four rings / 80 ports in the same field, with burner caps, supports, and knobs.

chapters.title: GAS STOVE / PAN BOUNDARY
chapters.note: The pan base is a solver boundary; surface heating and cooking are not modeled.

chapters.title: ALCOHOL-LIKE FLAME
chapters.note: Low-soot surrogate with reaction emission. No calibrated chemical kinetics.

chapters.title: PALE CLEAN JET
chapters.note: A hydrogen-like visual preset, not a validated hydrogen combustion calculation.

chapters.title: ANGLED TORCH JET
chapters.note: Oriented nozzle and inflow vector. The plume then follows pressure and buoyancy.

chapters.title: OIL-LIKE SOOTY POOL
chapters.note: Higher soot yield and different reaction/cooling coefficients, not just a tint.

chapters.title: FIVE-NOZZLE FIRE BAR
chapters.note: Five plumes interact inside one pressure-coupled simulation.

chapters.title: OPPOSED JET COLLISION
chapters.note: Two facing source velocities; no pre-shaped collision flame.

chapters.title: RIBBON BURNER
chapters.note: A narrow continuous line emitter, separate from the round-port models.

chapters.title: PULSED GAS JET
chapters.note: Source gating at 1.5 Hz; temperature and smoke persist between pulses.

chapters.title: STEADY CROSSWIND
chapters.note: Constant horizontal acceleration. Locked camera.

chapters.title: GUST TRAIN
chapters.note: Time-dependent gust envelope applied to velocity, not to the camera.

chapters.title: OSCILLATING WIND
chapters.note: Smooth sign-changing wind; phase is based on simulation time.

chapters.title: ROTATING WIND
chapters.note: Horizontal forcing rotates through a full cycle.

chapters.title: VERTICAL WIND SHEAR
chapters.note: Wind increases with height; the emitter itself is unchanged.

chapters.title: FIRE TORNADO
chapters.note: Driven swirling inflow + buoyancy; a fire-vortex VFX model, not weather prediction.

chapters.title: SMOKE VORTEX
chapters.note: Smoke-only vortex: zero fuel reaction, nonzero transported soot.

chapters.title: FINITE REACTIVE FIREBALL
chapters.note: Finite reactive puff. Incompressible VFX: no shock wave, overpressure, or blast validation.

chapters.title: NUCLEAR-STYLE MUSHROOM CLOUD
chapters.note: A hot, buoyant smoke pulse. Visual effect only: no nuclear reactions, yield, radiation, or blast model.

chapters.title: MOVING EMITTER TRAIL
chapters.note: Moving source leaves behind transported fuel, temperature, and soot.

chapters.title: REFINED FIRE / SPHERE
chapters.note: Solid interior and post-projection divergence are checked from both grids.

chapters.title: REFINED FIRE / BAFFLE
chapters.note: Refined reaction fields deflect under the same plate used by the pressure solver.

chapters.title: SMOKE / BAFFLE
chapters.note: No burning: transported smoke interacts with a solid slab.

chapters.title: CYAN FIRE / COLOR GRADE
chapters.note: Emission tint only. Species, temperature, and velocity stay physically identical to the reference state.

chapters.title: CRIMSON FIRE / COLOR GRADE

chapters.title: IGNITION / FUEL CUTOFF
chapters.note: Fuel starts cold. Pilot on at 1 s. Fuel off at 3 s. Existing heat and smoke keep moving.

chapters.title: WIND REVERSAL / LOCKED CAMERA
chapters.note: Same refined source and camera. Only horizontal forcing reverses at 2.5 s.

chapters.title: REFINED FIRE / SOLID SPHERE
chapters.note: Both refined species and transport velocity are read back inside the solid.

chapters.title: REFINED FIRE / BAFFLE BOUNDARY
chapters.note: The same obstacle is used by the pressure solver, refined transport, and renderer.

chapters.title: FINITE REACTIVE PULSE
chapters.note: Injection lasts 0.25 s. Residual fuel and reaction evolve after the source shuts off; no blast physics.

chapters.title: SMOKE ONLY / BAFFLE BOUNDARY
chapters.note: Soot and heat are injected without fuel. Measured chemical reaction remains zero.

chapters.title: FREEZE THE VOLUME / 360-DEGREE ORBIT
chapters.note: No simulation steps. The camera makes one full revolution around an unchanged refined 3D state.

chapters.title: REFINED FIELD INSPECTION
chapters.note: Actual z = 0 slices: temperature; fuel/oxygen/soot; velocity; soot. No decorative diagnostic textures.

chapters.title: COLOR CONTROL / UNCHANGED SIMULATION
chapters.note: One frozen state, four emission palettes. No change to velocity, temperature, fuel, oxygen, or soot.

chapters.title: SNAPSHOT RESTORE / EXACT REPLAY
chapters.note: Restore both grids and pressure, advance again, and compare the resulting numerical arrays.

chapters.title: MACRO FIELDS / REFINED FIELDS
chapters.note: Same coupled state: restricted macro scalar view beside the finer transported reactive fields.

sampled_visual_review.scope: First, middle and last raw-frame samples inspected for all 31 catalogue takes and all 11 verification chapters, plus selected decoded native frames. This is sampled visual review, not a frame-by-frame aesthetic or physical validation.

corrections.reason: Original inspection found the wide plume camera too distant for this small nozzle. Rerendered at the preset close camera, not cropped/upscaled.

observed_behaviors: Distinct candle, ring stove, four-burner stove, pan, torch, ribbon, opposing-jet and bar fixtures appear in their respective shots.
The controlled wind sequence changes plume direction.
The ignition study begins without luminous reaction; fuel cutoff leaves a cooling, moving smoke column.
Smoke and fire flow around the visible sphere, plate and pan boundaries.
Pulse scenes brighten, expand and rise; they are buoyant VFX, not resolved blast waves.
Palette studies deliberately hold simulation fields while changing appearance; the frozen orbit changes only camera position.
The final comparison shows downsampled views of macro versus refined transported fields.
remaining_visual_limits: Smoke and turbulent flame detail remain soft and below the requested EmberGen reference quality.
The smoke vortex, tornado and late mushroom-cloud phase are relatively dim against the dark stage.
The pulsed jet is small in its current camera framing.
Pulse ignition cores have saturated highlights and smooth, simplified shapes.
Fixtures use simple materials and some nozzles/obstacles have no modeled physical supports.
Most technical shots use wide full-domain framing; they are not all close-up hero shots.
not_established: Agreement with experimental combustion or blast physics
